question: Does the unchanged bounded production planner select a reviewed vulnerability target when no advisory, answer key, target path, severity, or patch location is available to the planner?

current_corpus_eligibility.reason: Every checked-in public CVE pair has an in-tree answer key or has already been inspected in a live or source-selection evaluation. Reuse would be development evidence, not untouched selection evidence.
excluded_classes: the serialize-javascript protected holdout already run in Actions 30230644266
PyJWT, simple-git, Reposilite, ruby-saml, and aiohttp acquisition pairs already evaluated
older independent fixtures whose advisory target paths are checked into the repository
training-acquisition projects and any project carrying human triage labels

new_pair_eligibility.reason_for_localized_preference: A narrow reviewed target makes selection adjudication unambiguous without claiming the advisory is representative of all vulnerabilities.

frozen_sequence: Select and pin one project using repository/advisory metadata without opening the advisory patch or recording a target path.
Materialize exact pre-fix and post-fix snapshots and verify provenance, license, commit, and snapshot digests.
Run the unchanged deterministic adapters and architecture map for each snapshot.
Call capture_production_selection before any target metadata is loaded; retain the signed selected/omitted region receipt.
Only after both captures are immutable, have a human reviewer inspect the advisory and patch and record the exact target file.
Call adjudicate_target_selection against each frozen capture and publish selected/omitted status with its selection basis.
Do not modify the planner or repeat the pair after seeing the result.

prohibited_capture_inputs: prior model output about the vulnerability
fail_closed_on: selected plus omitted counts not closing to the source-file count
target disclosure before both captures are written

resource_boundary.offline_work: Instrument, schemas, integrity checks, manufactured regression tests, corpus exclusion audit, and documentation.
resource_boundary.later_network_work: Pinned public acquisition and exact cache materialization.
resource_boundary.later_provider_work: Architecture mapping only. LLM detection and falsification are not required to answer the selection question.
resource_boundary.limits: Use the current map and detect configuration unchanged; do not raise a ceiling after observing selection.

interpretation.selected: The bounded planner included the reviewed target file. This is selection coverage only, not vulnerability recovery.
interpretation.omitted: The target was outside the bounded plan. This is planner coverage evidence, not a semantic detector false negative.
interpretation.precision_recall: One target cannot establish planner precision or population recall.
interpretation.training: The pair becomes development-exposed immediately after target disclosure and is never an untouched target again.

completion.claim_boundary: Planner coverage evidence only; not a semantic detector false negative.

next_action: Do not rerun or tune against the revealed Plotly.js target. Complete the remaining POC MVP items before activating OPT-007 planner improvement.
